title: Behind the Sound: How Logitech Engineered the Audio for Zone Vibe Pro
summary: From acoustic heritage to modern hybrid work, go behind the scenes at Logitech’s Camas studio. Matt Green, Head of Acoustics at Logitech, breaks down how decades of audio expertise shaped the sound quality and noise-canceling performance of Zone Vibe Pro and Zone Vibe Pro for Business. https://youtu.be/1kVdn2ajX8o
